race.comment: GUNZ (3) looks the one to beat third-up. He was solid fresh on heavy ground at Ballarat before just finding one better at Seymour. Peaks now and will roll forward for Jamie Mott, up to 1200m is the unknown but he'll be in front for a long way. TREBILCO (4) won well enough fresh at Morphettville in a Class 2 then struggled to 1400m last start at Ballarat. Like him back in trip and with even luck slotting in he can bounce back. EXTREME TURBO (8) was a smart maiden winner on debut then clearly didn't handle the heavy 10 at Kyneton. He can do much better. OLE DAZE (7) was okay fresh at Seymour but showed ability in town last campaign and is in the right camp to improve.
